name: UGC Product Video
outcome: Turn creator and product references into a polished 15-second vertical testimonial with native voice, animated captions, motion graphics, and an exact branded close.
audience: Founder-led brands, creators, and paid social teams.
summary: Choose the message before generating footage. Write one complete 15-second script, keep one creator identity, and give Seedance 2.5 a separate product reference.
Generate picture, voice, and lip-sync together in one AtlasCloud pass. Keep the cup out of the opening, show it only from 4.5 to 7.0 seconds, then return to the creator alone for the close.
Transcribe the generated audio, group the words into readable captions, and add a restrained motion system with a reviewable branded close.
caveats: Use a creator image you have permission to send to the selected video provider and publish.
The product demonstration is generative. Check labels, geometry, product timing, and every factual claim before publishing.
Reference image 1 controls the creator and scene. Reference image 2 controls only the product. Do not let either reference transfer its background into the other.
Automatic captions follow the generated recording rather than the requested script. Review every word, highlight, and timing before publishing.

apps.role: One guided surface carries the offer, ordered reference images, native-audio testimonial, and final review.
Use the focused revoicing app only when preserving an existing recorded performance matters more than native video-model audio.
Use the launch kit when product imagery matters more than the creator-led edit.

steps.handoff: Compare plain, playful, and premium routes before writing one spoken 15-second testimonial.

Select Seedance 2.5 on AtlasCloud. Give it image 1 for creator identity and image 2 for product identity, then generate voice, lip-sync, natural phone motion, and the brief 4.5–7.0 second product beat in one pass.

Choose a caption style and optional brand accent. The workflow transcribes the generated clip, adds animated captions and restrained graphic beats, then renders the exact brand and slogan over the close while preserving native audio.
